name: Suspicious File Download From IP Via Wget.EXE - Paths
description: Detects potentially suspicious file downloads directly from IP addresses and stored in suspicious locations using Wget.exe
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.executable:*\\wget.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:wget.exe) AND process.command_line:/:\/\/[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}/ AND process.command_line:*http* AND (process.command_line:/\s-O\s/ OR process.command_line:*\-\-output\-document*) AND ((process.command_line:(*\:\\PerfLogs\\* OR *\:\\Temp\\* OR *\:\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\Help\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\Temporary\ Internet*)) OR (process.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND process.command_line:*\\Favorites\\*) OR (process.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND process.command_line:*\\Favourites\\*) OR (process.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND process.command_line:*\\Contacts\\*) OR (process.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND process.command_line:*\\Pictures\\*))
